name: Judging Fellow Christians
overview: Scripture instructs believers to refrain from harsh or superficial judgment of fellow Christians, emphasizing mercy and forgiveness rather than condemnation. Jesus teaches not to judge others so that we ourselves will not be judged, urging us to judge with righteousness rather than mere outward appearances. The Apostle Paul reinforces this by encouraging the acceptance of those weak in faith without engaging in disputes or passing judgment on their consciences, reminding us that each servant stands or falls before their own Master, God. Instead of judging, believers are called to avoid causing others to stumble, promoting unity and love within the body of Christ.
